cards.ex: He keeps promising, but actions speak louder than words, so I'm waiting to see what he actually does.
cards.exUz: U va'da beryapti, lekin amal gapdan muhimroq, shuning uchun men uning nima qilishini kutaman.
cards.uzDef: Gapdan ko'ra amaliy ishlar ko'proq ahamiyatga ega ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: Investing in that company seems risky; remember to look before you leap.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniyaga sarmoya kiritish xavfli ko'rinadi; esda tuting, o'ylab qadam bosing.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishdan oldin oqibatlarini yaxshilab o'ylab ko'rish kerakligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The project failed because there were too many cooks in the kitchen, all with different ideas.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, chunki oshxonada ko'p oshpaz bor edi, ularning barchasi turli g'oyalarga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p odam aralashsa ish buziladi, degan ma'noda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I know it's not the job you wanted, but beggars can't be choosers right now.
cards.exUz: Bilaman, bu siz xohlagan ish emas, lekin hozir muhtoj tanlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj odam shart qo'yishga haqli emas, degan ma'noni bildiradi.

cards.ex: Let's not worry about the logistics yet; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
cards.exUz: Hozir logistika haqida qayg'urmaylik; biz ko'prikdan o'tganda hal qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammo tug'ilganda hal qilish kerakligini anglatadi, hozir emas.

cards.ex: He won the lottery, but blew it all in a month. Easy come, easy go.
cards.exUz: U lotereyada yutdi, lekin bir oy ichida hammasini sarfladi. Oson keldi, oson ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan topilgan narsa, osonlik bilan yo'qotiladi.

cards.ex: I lost my job, but every cloud has a silver lining; now I can pursue my passion.
cards.exUz: Men ishimni yo'qotdim, lekin har bulutda bir umid bor; endi men o'z ishtiyoqim bilan shug'ullanishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi tomonga umid borligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: He took a big risk starting his own business, but fortune favors the bold.
cards.exUz: U o'z biznesini boshlashda katta xavf tug'dirdi, lekin omad jasurlarga kuladi.
cards.uzDef: Omad jasurlarga kulib boqadi.

cards.ex: Don't rush the project; haste makes waste, so take your time and do it right.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bilan shoshilmang; shoshilinchda xato ko'p, shuning uchun vaqtingizni oling va to'g'ri bajaring.
cards.uzDef: Shoshqaloqlik bilan qilingan ishlar ko'pincha yomon natijalarga olib keladi.

cards.ex: I can kill two birds with one stone by picking up the groceries on my way home from work.
cards.exUz: Men ishdan uyga qaytayotganda oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini olib, bir harakat bilan ikkita maqsadga erishishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat bilan ikkita maqsadga erishish.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job, so be patient with yourself.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishni o'rganish vaqt talab etadi, shuning uchun o'zingizga sabrli bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishning asoslarini, qoidalarini o'rganish.

cards.ex: The weather is perfect for harvesting, so we need to make hay while the sun shines.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo hosil yig'ish uchun juda mos, shuning uchun biz quyosh charaqlab turganda pichanni yig'ishtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatdan unumli foydalanish, ayniqsa vaqt cheklangan bo'lsa.

cards.ex: Working hard is tough, but no pain, no gain, right?
cards.exUz: Qattiq ishlash qiyin, lekin azobsiz rohat yo'q, to'g'rimi?
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tish kerak.

cards.ex: She moved to another country, and eventually, she was out of sight, out of mind.
cards.exUz: U boshqa davlatga ko'chib o'tdi va oxir-oqibat u ko'zdan g'oyib bo'ldi, ko'ngildan ham o'chdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'zdan g'oyib bo'lgan narsa, ko'ngildan ham o'chadi.

cards.ex: Don't worry about making mistakes; practice makes perfect.
cards.exUz: Xato qilishdan xavotirlanmang; mashq mukammallikka yetaklaydi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy mashq qilish orqali mahorat oshadi.

cards.ex: He was ahead in the game, so he decided to quit while he was ahead.
cards.exUz: U o'yinda oldinda edi, shuning uchun u oldinda bo'lganida to'xtashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi paytda to'xtash, vaziyat yomonlashmasdan oldin.

cards.ex: Be patient with yourself; Rome wasn't built in a day.
cards.exUz: O'zingizga sabrli bo'ling; Rim bir kunda qurilmagan.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadga erishish uchun vaqt va sabr kerak.

cards.ex: They were interested in our product, so we needed to strike while the iron was hot.
cards.exUz: Ular bizning mahsulotimizga qiziqish bildirishdi, shuning uchun biz temir issig'ida bosishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatdan darhol foydalanish.

cards.ex: I got the best deals because the early bird catches the worm.
cards.exUz: Men eng yaxshi kelishuvlarga erishdim, chunki erta turgan chuvalchangni tutadi.
cards.uzDef: Erta turgan odam maqsadga erishadi.

cards.ex: He yelled at me, but two wrongs don't make a right, so I stayed calm.
cards.exUz: U menga baqirdi, lekin ikki xato to'g'ri ish bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun men xotirjam qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Yomonlikka yomonlik bilan javob qaytarish muammoni hal qilmaydi.

cards.ex: I love traveling because variety is the spice of life.
cards.exUz: Men sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki rang-baranglik hayotning ziynati.
cards.uzDef: Har xillik zerikishni oldini oladi va hayotni qiziqarli qiladi.

cards.ex: First I lost my job, then my car broke down. When it rains, it pours!
cards.exUz: Avval ishimni yo'qotdim, keyin mashinam buzildi. Yomg'ir yog'sa sel bo'ladi!
cards.uzDef: Muammolar birdaniga ko'payib ketishi.

cards.ex: He might look rough, but you can't judge a book by its cover; he's actually very kind.
cards.exUz: U qo'pol ko'rinishi mumkin, lekin kitobga qarab baho berma; u aslida juda mehribon.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni tashqi ko'rinishiga qarab baholash noto'g'ri.

cards.ex: If you work hard and are kind to others, you'll reap what you sow.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qattiq ishlasangiz va boshqalarga mehribon bo'lsangiz, unda nima eksangiz shuni o'rasiz.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishlaringiz natijasini ko'rasiz.

cards.ex: I know I'm late with the payment, but better late than never.
cards.exUz: To'lovni kechiktirganimni bilaman, lekin kech bo'lsa ham, hech bo'lmaganidan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: O'z vaqtida bo'lmagandan ko'ra, kechroq bo'lgani yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: We haven't won the game yet, so don't count your chickens before they hatch.
cards.exUz: Biz hali o'yinda g'alaba qozonmadik, shuning uchun jo'jani sanamang.
cards.uzDef: Natija aniq bo'lmaguncha xursand bo'lmang.

cards.ex: I'm always looking for deals because a penny saved is a penny earned.
cards.exUz: Men har doim kelishuvlarni qidiraman, chunki tejalgan pul topilgan pul bilan barobar.
cards.uzDef: Pulni tejash - pul topish bilan barobar.

cards.ex: They're always together because birds of a feather flock together.
cards.exUz: Ular doim birga, chunki bir xil qushlar birga bo'lishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash odamlar birga bo'lishga moyil.

cards.ex: I'm investing in different stocks; you shouldn't put all your eggs in one basket.
cards.exUz: Men turli xil aktsiyalarga sarmoya kirityapman; siz barcha tuxumlarni bitta savatga solmasligingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barcha resurslarni bitta narsaga tikmaslik kerak.

cards.ex: I told him the truth, because honesty is the best policy.
cards.exUz: Men unga haqiqatni aytdim, chunki halollik eng yaxshi siyosat.
cards.uzDef: Doim rost gapirish yaxshiroq.
